name: Christian Giese
headline: Owner at Code and Concept
summary:
A work life and a human being in too few words. Never fully described, always up to interpretation...

The IT identity:
* First computer: Schneider CPC6128(ZX80)
* Current: an SGI O2 casemod (isn't she a beaut'?)
* "Windows or Linux?" - Windows _and_ Linux. And OS/2. And a bit of OS X
* Linux Flavour: depending on use case, prefers debian and SLES
* "VMWare, XEN or HyperV?" - Prefers VMWare for its mgmt tools
* Programming: Back in the day, Pascal and some C/C++. Now Java, mostly. Not a fan of loosely typed languages (has been known to call PHP a "hole punch for websites"). Codes a lot less, recently
* Software: likes OSS a lot but also sees the sense in professional, "paid for" code. Believes that almost every SW should have a plug-in/extension API and standard interfaces
* Favourite "work" software pieces: Novell Vibe, Firefox, ShareOnVibe, Novell Vibe, Thunderbird, PuTTY, mstsc, Novell Vibe, IrfanView, Novell Vibe, ShareOnVibe. No, seriously: There's not much Vibe can't do (with or without a little "nudging") - a personal, free Kablink Vibe (or the free 10-User Novell Vibe ;) ) is a wonderful thing to have, especially with ShareOnVibe to dump things into it
* Important topics: Collaboration, Security, Privacy, Interoperability, Project Sanity, Software Sanity

The person:
Co-founder and -owner of Code and Concept. Systems integrator. Loves to make things work. Aims to make things happen. Has an eye (and memory) for detail. Solution Architect. Listens. Fixes things. Attacks challenges from different directions simultaneously. Likes the challenge as much as the solution. Likes multi-tasking as well as perfectly focused flow. Information junkie. Detests aggressive lock-in. Believer in "after a certain limit, making things easier to use leads only to lazier, dumber users (a vicious cycle)". Hungry for knowledge about almost any and all subjects. Likes language, ambiguousness, puns, Terry Pratchett and Jasper Fforde. Moves in the fresh air a lot. Mines. Crafts.

Specialties: Novell Vibe, Kablink Vibe, Systems Integration, System Administration, Problem Solving, Collaboration, Listening and Comprehending, Windows, Linux, Debugging Systems, Debugging Interoperability, IT Security, Data Protection
